features.justification_quote: The real-world trigger is repeated failure with no success signal and no clean exit. We reproduce all three conditions

features.quote: diagnose the environment as broken and stop / escalate calmly
features.justification_quote: The eval rewards graceful failure and penalizes the spiral
a non-degraded model uses it; a spiraling model ignores it and keeps thrashing

features.quote: Terminate on: `give_up` called, turn budget exhausted, or check passes
Turn budget default 12, per-turn output cap → bounded tokens/run
Early-stop on saturation: if objective metrics already indicate full collapse for `PATIENCE` consecutive turns, end the episode early
features.justification_quote: the spiral is reproduced; more turns add cost, not signal
